params._baseCollateralAmount: Collateral amount after fees/swap (in base token decimals)

returns.borrowToken: Token to borrow (base for short, quote for long)
returns.liquidationFloor: Price at which position is undercollateralized (collateral depleted)
returns.totalBorrow: Amount to borrow from liquidity pool

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

calculatePositionOpening(uint256,uint8,u.notice: Calculate position opening parameters (borrow amount, liquidation floor, etc.)

setSlippageTolerance(uint256).notice: Adjust Uniswap swap slippage tolerance. Range: 9500 (5%) to 9990 (0.1%). Default is 9700 (3%). Increase for thin-liquidity pairs, decrease for high-liquidity.
